author: Gavin (gmarcialcalleja)
summary: Test actual Swift telemetry bytes through accepted relay and simulated policy
details: Compile an unchanged pinned CS-016 review package to generate synthetic left/center/right, clock, health and limited-tracking wire data. Add seven integration checks for role binding, original capture age, channel mapping, cancellation, expiry and replay/epoch rejection. Preserve explicit native-transport, lifecycle, device-clock and physical acceptance gaps.
validation: Swift 6.0.3 Linux Docker compilation/generation passed with strict concurrency and warnings as errors, network disabled. Seven focused Python integration tests passed on Windows. No real phone, Pi, camera, network device, GPIO or motor used.
